source: docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md section 10 (the live set and R*), section 11 (outcomes, the verdict ladder, units, statistics, effect sizes, the testing order) and section 13 item 4, approved 2026-10-30 as recommended (D-021); ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json baselines.age_only (D-034)
rule: Section 13 item 4, frozen by commit before the verdict code that reads it and before the first evaluation block. Every value restates section 11 or 10; where the design leaves a judging choice open it is listed under open_choices with its options and resolution null, and the verdict code then reports the verdict under every option and claims one only when all options agree. A change is a new file version, labelled post hoc in the design's As-built section; tests/test_l7v2_verdict_prereg.py pins the sha256 and every value.

minimum_cut.use: section 14's fallback only, decided before the campaign; never after a block

best_rule.definition: R* is the rule arm with the best validation recall at the common budget (section 10)
best_rule.candidates_reading: the four tuned rule arms whose section-10 row says 'the best of the rule arms runs live' or 'may be the live rule'; the population-level detector (replay only, C1's detector) and the fixed replays (default rules, tolerant rules, nginx limits; untuned) are reported, never R*
best_rule.data: validation captures only, frozen in the selection before the first evaluation block

primary.harm: Q in the attack window on judged links (design 5.2), in percent
primary.benign_acted_on: benign users wrongly acted on at level 1 or level 2, per run, attributed from the manifest

secondary: time to mitigate: attack start to the first 5 consecutive 1-s bins with Q >= 99 %
time to decision per attack entity

detection.source: the replay of each U run's recording through every arm at its frozen operating point (the same traffic for every arm)
metrics: entity recall at the frozen operating point
benign FP per benign kind, held-out kinds included

units.block: one evaluation seed with its own IP pool

harm.supported: at least min_blocks blocks, the 95 % t-interval of the mean block difference excludes 0, and at least same_sign_share of the blocks have the sign of the mean (run_level_stats.decide)

stages: attack entities with replacement within each drawn block
detection.statistic: the difference of pooled entity recall between two arms on the same resampled entities, in pp

power.when: every harm contrast that is not shown

effect_sizes.harm_beats: the paired contrast is supported in the arm's favour and its mean is >= harm_beats_pp of Q
effect_sizes.harm_equivalence: the 95 % t-interval of the paired contrast lies strictly inside +-harm_equivalence_pp, over at least min_blocks blocks
effect_sizes.detection_beats: the recall difference is >= detection_beats_pp and its bootstrap interval excludes 0
effect_sizes.detection_equivalence: the bootstrap interval of the recall difference lies strictly inside +-detection_equivalence_pp
effect_sizes.loses: the other arm beats this one by the same rule

testing_order_rule: fixed sequence at family-wise alpha 0.05: a step is tested only when every earlier step passed; harm_admission passes when the class is admitted, budget when at least one enforcing arm meets the budget, best_learned_vs_rstar when the best learned arm beats R* on harm, gru_vs_hgb when the GRU beats the HGB on detection; gru_vs_shuffled is the last

ladder.name: no advantage, or no harm
ladder.when: U fails harm admission; or no enforcing arm meets the budget on the evaluation seeds; or no arm mitigates (Q(M) - Q(U) not supported in M's favour for any live M of the class)

ladder.name: the GRU beats all
ladder.when: the GRU meets the budget, beats every live baseline arm of the class on harm, and beats the HGB and the shuffled-GRU on detection by >= 10 pp

ladder.name: learning helps, sequence does not
ladder.when: the best learned arm beats R* on harm, and the GRU is not V-A because it is equivalent to the HGB or to the shuffled-GRU on detection, or loses to one of them

ladder.name: rules suffice
ladder.when: the best learned arm is equivalent to R* on harm

ladder.name: none of the above
ladder.when: no rung above holds: reported with the power calculation, no verdict claimed

ladder_rule: per class, the first rung that holds, in the order listed (V-D, V-A, V-B, V-C, inconclusive)

age_only.rule: the age-only baseline's validation AUC must lie within 0.5 +- band (ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json baselines.age_only); outside it every view-level result is age-confounded and V-A is not claimed

benign_model.rule: a C3b result against a structureless benign model cannot support V-A (design 12.1); as built the trained benign navigation is TPC-W browsing (design As built), so the runner states it per class

record.rule: only a frozen calibration record gives a verdict (ml/l7v2_prereg.json harm.verdict_record); a placeholder or measured record is refused

readings.text: Harm contrasts are differences of Q in pp, arm minus comparator, paired by block, judged by eval/run_level_stats.decide and t_interval unchanged.

Detection contrasts compare the arms' replays of the same U runs: the difference of pooled entity recall at each arm's frozen operating point, with the two-stage cluster bootstrap of statistics.detection.

V-A's harm contrasts against the live baselines other than R* (for C3b the default rules and the HGB) are taken jointly with step best_learned_vs_rstar as an intersection-union test, each at alpha 0.05, all of which must be 'beats'; an intersection-union test needs no multiplicity adjustment [INFERENCE: Berger 1982].
V-B's 'equivalent to, or loses to, the HGB or the shuffled-GRU' uses the detection contrasts of V-A (the shuffled-GRU never runs live, so it has no harm runs).
V-D's mitigation test is run_level_stats.decide of Q(M) - Q(U) per live M of the class; 'supported (+)' for at least one M means some arm mitigates.
When the V-A conditions hold but a V-A block applies (age-confounded, structureless benign model), the class is inconclusive with the block named; V-B, V-C and V-D are unaffected.
The shuffled-GRU of the ladder is the plain variant (models.gru_shuffled); the pin_first variant is reported beside it and is never judged.
The detection bootstrap's seed is fixed here for reproducibility; it judges nothing.

open_choices.question: Which arm is 'the best learned arm' of V-B and V-C (it matters for C3b only, where the GRU and the HGB both run live)?

options.eval_q: the live learned arm with the higher mean Q over the evaluation blocks (ties: the GRU)
options.validation: the live learned arm with the higher validation recall at the budget, frozen in the selection before evaluation (ties: the GRU)
options.gru: the GRU, the design's focal arm

open_choices.question: On which measure does an arm 'meet the budget on the evaluation seeds' (V-A, V-D)?

options.replay: its benign units flagged in the replay of the U runs at its frozen operating point, pooled over the evaluation blocks, <= floor(0.01 x the benign units pooled)
options.live: the benign users wrongly acted on (level 1 or 2) in its own M runs, pooled over the evaluation blocks, <= floor(0.01 x the benign users pooled)

open_choices.question: Does V-A's 'every live baseline arm' include U?

options.with_u: every live arm of the class other than the GRU, U included
options.detectors_only: the live detector arms only (default rules, R*, HGB), U excluded

open_choices.question: What is the verdict when R* beats the best learned arm on harm (no rung of section 11 names that case)?

options.inconclusive: inconclusive, as the table's 'none of the above'
options.v_c: V-C, read as 'rules suffice or win'
